title: Module 1: Algorithmic Bias and Where It Comes From
description: Disentangle the six sources of algorithmic bias (historical, representation, measurement, aggregation, evaluation, deployment feedback) and match each to its appropriate intervention.
learning_objectives: Name and distinguish six sources of algorithmic bias.
Diagnose which bias sources are present in a real-world AI failure case.
Match each bias source to an appropriate engineering or non-engineering intervention.
Recognize when post-processing 'debiasing' cannot fix the underlying problem.
